scripts.build:wasm: em++ src/ChessEngine/*.cpp -std=c++23 -O3 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=134217728 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_get_best_move -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=ccall,cwrap -o src/ChessEngine.js && mv src/ChessEngine.wasm public/
scripts.predeploy: npm run build:wasm && npm run build
